701:t_009:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I'm sorry, $$次元獣$$... I have no strength left to fight anymore...」

701:t_010:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... couldn't atone for the lives I took...」

701:t_010:1.en:
$n
「The people who died aren't here anymore...」

701:t_010:2.en:
$n
「Atoning to those people matters too... But if you call yourself a general, you should have looked for what you could do for the people who are still alive.」

701:t_010:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you came up with, beyond both hope and despair...」

701:t_010:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it's an answer, though...」

701:t_010:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

701:t_010:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Anyone will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You who have achieved $$真化融合$$ should be able to.」

701:t_010:7.en:
$n
「...How am I supposed to do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

701:t_010:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've been dealing with the $$次元将$$ since the days of the $$破界事変$$. This one's my job, I'd say.」

701:t_010:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$揺れる天秤$$, huh... I thank you for your strong will.」

701:t_010:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Knock it off. I don't need to hear that from the guy whose life I'm about to take.」

701:t_010:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... If you run into $$ガイオウ$$, pass this on for me.」

701:t_010:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That we're standing up to a future of despair.」

701:t_011:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... couldn't atone for the lives I took...」

701:t_011:1.en:

「The people who died aren't here anymore...」

$$ヴィルダーク$$

701:t_011:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$

701:t_011:7.en:
$n
「...How am I supposed to do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

701:t_012:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The cursed wanderer, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... Were you drawn here by the $$スフィア$$s too?」

701:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$. I'll carry on your feelings myself.」

701:t_012:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's dirty, $$アサキム$$! You're gonna snatch his $$スフィア$$s out from under us!?」

701:t_012:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If it's to take my revenge on them, I'll do anything, even scavenge off corpses.」

701:t_012:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As long as you defeat the $$御使い$$s, either of you is fine. I leave what comes after to you.」

701:t_013:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is what happens.」

701:t_014:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've taken back your four $$スフィア$$s.」

701:t_014:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$喜びのアドヴェント$$...!」

701:t_014:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アウストラリス$$... $$アドナキエル$$ the General...」

701:t_014:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In consideration of your achievements until now, I took your life so that you wouldn't suffer.」

701:t_014:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$アドナキエル$$.」

701:t_014:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't call me by that name!」

701:t_014:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am... the $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$!!」

701:t_015:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You seem displeased, $$アサキム$$.」

701:t_015:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But this is a rightful act. After all, we are the original owners of the $$スフィア$$s.」

701:t_015:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That arrogance... I can't forgive it.」

701:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「A wise decision. He knows his own strength.」

701:t_016:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At any rate, this means the four $$スフィア$$s have come back to us.」

701:t_016:2.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Are you going to fight us with the power of those $$スフィア$$s?」

701:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You don't understand anything, $n.」

701:t_016:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The $$スフィア$$s are not a power meant for fighting. They exist to save this universe.」

701:t_016:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be waiting for you, $c. To save the entire universe, your power is needed too.」

701:t_017:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's no use, $n. He warped out to retreat.」

701:t_017:2.en:
$$桂$$
「But showing himself in front of us was his mistake.」

701:t_017:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return at once. We'll follow the trail of the $$烙印$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and chase him by warp as well.」

701:t_017:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll pay you back for everything so far!」

701:t_017:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Next, it's our turn to storm in where you are!」

701:t_017:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$ヴィルダーク$$... I still can't accept you, after all...)

701:t_017:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But I'll grant your wish, and $$尸空#pilot$$'s too. By taking those guys down.)

701:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Just like you learned to draw out the power of four $$スフィア$$s, I've learned to draw out the power of $$ザンボット$$!」

701:t_100:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So are you saying that makes you my equal?」

701:t_100:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's not it! I've become stronger than you!」

701:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「No way I lose to a guy who fights while fooling his own heart, when I'm fighting believing in myself and my machine!」

701:t_100:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's the spirit! Come, warrior!!」

701:t_101:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even your solar disc cannot light up this dark $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

701:t_101:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「If there isn't enough light, we'll shine even brighter! We will never stop struggling... never stop growing!」

701:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「We're not like you! We won't lose to someone who sets their own limits and can only live within them!」

701:t_101:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I'll teach you! That there are powers that still can't be reached!」

701:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A president whose subordinates won't follow is meaningless! Quit calling yourself a $$次元将$$!」

701:t_102:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I can't do that. I too bear responsibility for what I have done to get here.」
